subject: Embedding 3-D htmlwidget Plot (threejs) in a Shiny Presentation

messages.author: c899f40832471ec1
messages.subject: Embedding 3-D htmlwidget Plot (threejs) in a Shiny Presentation
parts:
I am trying to embed a threejs plot in a shiny presentation. When I run the presentation (in Chromium) the 3-D plot shows up in an external viewer, and not within the presentation.  The plot is correct, it is just not embedded.  If I run it in RStudio I don't see the plot -- just the slide.  

Any help, or pointers, on getting the plot embedded would be great.  A reproducible example is below:


---
title: "Reproducible Example"
author: "Matt Brigida"
affiliation:
date: "06/01/2015"
output: ioslides_presentation
runtime: shiny
smaller: true
---


## 3-D Chart


```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(threejs)
inputPanel(    
   sliderInput("axis1", label = "Max Axis 1", max = .5, min = 0.01, value = .20, step = .01),
   sliderInput("axis2", label = "Max Axis 2", max = .2, min = 0.01, value = .05, step = .01)
   )


renderPlot({
  surf <- cbind(expand.grid(seq(.01, input$axis1, by = .01), seq(.01, input$axis2, by = .01)), 1)
  scatterplot3js(as.matrix(surf), bg = "black", color = "green")
})
```
